description: The line plot illustrates the memory usage (in gigabytes) of four different models—VideoLLaMB, VideoLLaMB-R, LLaVA-NeXT, and VideoLLAVA—across varying numbers of input frames, ranging from 0 to 1000. The x-axis represents the number of frames, plotted on a linear scale, while the y-axis shows memory consumption in gigabytes, also on a linear scale. Each model is represented by a distinct colored line with corresponding markers: VideoLLaMB (pink, circle), VideoLLaMB-R (brown, circle), LLaVA-NeXT (teal, circle), and VideoLLAVA (purple, circle). VideoLLaMB and VideoLLaMB-R exhibit nearly identical memory usage, starting at approximately 2 GB and increasing linearly to about 3.5 GB at 1000 frames. LLaVA-NeXT shows a steady increase from around 2 GB to approximately 140 GB. In contrast, VideoLLAVA demonstrates a dramatically different pattern, starting at about 2 GB and rising sharply to over 420 GB at 1000 frames, indicating a significant increase in memory consumption with frame count.
